content:
Compound interest is interest earned on interest — and over long periods it is the single biggest driver of investment growth. This draft post will explain the formula, the Rule of 72, and why starting early beats saving more later.

## The formula

```
A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt)
```

Work in progress — example and charts to follow.
